import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from io import StringIO

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    stock_balance = inputs["stock_balance"].copy()
    applied_movements_df = inputs["applied_movements"].copy()
    movements = inputs["movements"].copy()
    
    # Get the set of already-applied movement IDs
    applied_set = set(applied_movements_df["movement_id"].values) if len(applied_movements_df) > 0 else set()
    
    # Initialize balance dict: (sku, warehouse) -> on_hand
    balance = {}
    for _, row in stock_balance.iterrows():
        balance[(row["sku"], row["warehouse"])] = row["on_hand"]
    
    # Sort movements by movement_ts, then line_no
    movements = movements.sort_values(by=["movement_ts", "line_no"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Track which movement_ids have been applied in this run
    applied_this_run = set()
    
    # List to collect rejects
    rejects = []
    
    # Process each line
    for _, row in movements.iterrows():
        line_no = row["line_no"]
        movement_id = row["movement_id"]
        sku = row["sku"]
        warehouse = row["warehouse"]
        qty = row["qty"]
        
        # Check if movement was already applied (before or during this run)
        if movement_id in applied_set or movement_id in applied_this_run:
            # Skip silently
            continue
        
        # Get current on_hand (defaults to 0 if key doesn't exist)
        key = (sku, warehouse)
        current_on_hand = balance.get(key, 0)
        
        # Check if applying would overdraw
        new_on_hand = current_on_hand + qty
        if new_on_hand < 0:
            # Reject the line
            rejects.append({"line_no": line_no, "reason": "INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"})
            # Do NOT mark movement_id as applied, so it stays retryable
        else:
            # Apply the movement
            balance[key] = new_on_hand
            applied_this_run.add(movement_id)
    
    # Build new_balance: include all keys from stock_balance, plus any new keys from movements
    new_balance_rows = []
    
    # Start with all original balance keys
    all_keys = set(balance.keys())
    
    for key in all_keys:
        sku, warehouse = key
        on_hand = balance[key]
        new_balance_rows.append({"sku": sku, "warehouse": warehouse, "on_hand": on_hand})
    
    new_balance_df = pd.DataFrame(new_balance_rows) if new_balance_rows else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["sku", "warehouse", "on_hand"]
    )
    
    # Build applied_out: original applied_movements + newly applied ones
    all_applied = list(applied_set | applied_this_run)
    applied_out_df = pd.DataFrame({"movement_id": all_applied}) if all_applied else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["movement_id"]
    )
    
    # Build movement_rejects
    movement_rejects_df = pd.DataFrame(rejects) if rejects else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=["line_no", "reason"]
    )
    
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    if len(new_balance_df) > 0:
        new_balance_df = new_balance_df.astype({"sku": "object", "warehouse": "object", "on_hand": "int64"})
    else:
        new_balance_df = new_balance_df.astype({"sku": "object", "warehouse": "object", "on_hand": "int64"})
    
    if len(applied_out_df) > 0:
        applied_out_df = applied_out_df.astype({"movement_id": "object"})
    else:
        applied_out_df = applied_out_df.astype({"movement_id": "object"})
    
    if len(movement_rejects_df) > 0:
        movement_rejects_df = movement_rejects_df.astype({"line_no": "int64", "reason": "object"})
    else:
        movement_rejects_df = movement_rejects_df.astype({"line_no": "int64", "reason": "object"})
    
    return {
        "new_balance": new_balance_df,
        "applied_out": applied_out_df,
        "movement_rejects": movement_rejects_df,
    }
